rationale: v1.80.1 already auto-places devices when a new room is bound to an HA Area, but incorrectly treats that intentional placement as new-device discovery. This changes only the existing attention marker, without new configuration fields or placement behaviour.

summary.ru: Убрана красная отметка у устройств, автоматически размещённых в новой HA-привязанной комнате.
summary.en: Removed the new-device red dot from devices automatically placed in a newly created HA-bound room.
